title.en: Fable 17 — The Dog and His Reflection

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: A dog found a big piece of meat.

sentences.ar: הוא לקח אותה בפה והלך הביתה.
sentences.en: He took it in his mouth and went home.

sentences.ar: הוא היה שמח מאוד באותו יום.
sentences.en: He was very happy that day.
On the way he came to a small bridge.
He stopped and looked down, at the water.

sentences.ar: גם לכלב הזה היה בשר בפה.
sentences.en: That dog too had meat in its mouth.

sentences.ar: הוא חשב: הבשר שלו גדול יותר.
sentences.en: He thought: his meat is bigger.

sentences.ar: הוא חשב: אני רוצה גם אותו.
sentences.en: He thought: I want it too.

sentences.ar: הוא פתח את הפה כדי לצעוק.
sentences.en: He opened his mouth in order to bark.
His meat fell into the water.
He saw it going down and disappearing.
He looked for the other dog.

sentences.ar: גם הוא לא היה שם יותר.
sentences.en: It too was no longer there.
The dog stood on the bridge alone.

sentences.ar: מי שרודף אחרי צל מאבד את שלו.
sentences.en: Whoever chases after a shadow loses his own.
